title: Russian missile strikes kill three and damage bridges in Kyiv
seoTitle: Russian missile strikes on Kyiv bridges kill three
dek: Russian overnight missile and drone strikes hit bridges and critical infrastructure in Kyiv, killing three employees and injuring 15 people, following Ukrainian attacks on the Kerch Bridge.
happened: On 20 November, Russian forces launched ballistic missile and drone strikes targeting Kyiv and several other regions, according to local officials. According to Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko, the strikes hit the Podilskyi, Darnytskyi, and Pivdennyi bridges across the Dnieper River, leading to closures and traffic restrictions. Officials reported that three employees of the water supply company Kyivvodokanal were killed and 15 others were injured at a critical infrastructure facility. According to the energy company DTEK, emergency power outages were implemented across the capital. Attacks were also reported in the Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Lviv, and Ivano-Frankivsk regions. In Poland, authorities scrambled fighter jets following suspected airspace violations by unidentified aerial objects near the Ukrainian border. The strikes followed statements by Russian President Vladimir Putin on 19 November vowing a painful response after Ukrainian forces launched three attacks on the Kerch Bridge during the preceding week.

sides.says: Officials reported that overnight Russian missile strikes killed three people and injured 15 others in Kyiv, damaging three key bridges and a critical infrastructure facility. Mayor Vitali Klitschko urged residents to avoid driving into the city unless necessary.

The ministry stated that its forces launched a strike hitting military-industrial facilities, missile and drone production and storage sites, as well as energy and transport infrastructure in Kyiv and six regions, alongside port infrastructure in Odesa.

Russian President Vladimir Putin stated on 19 November that Russia's response to Ukrainian attacks on the Kerch Bridge would be "much more painful than what the Kyiv regime has done to the bridge," adding that the bridge will be restored.

next: Specialists will assess the extent of the damage to the bridge structures once air raid alerts end, and cleanup and emergency response efforts continue across Kyiv.
summary: Russia launched overnight missile and drone strikes on Kyiv, killing three water supply workers and injuring 15 people. The attacks damaged three bridges across the Dnieper River and disrupted traffic and power supplies in the capital. The strikes occurred after Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed a painful retaliation following a series of Ukrainian attacks on the Kerch Bridge connecting Russia and Crimea.
